description: Render options of the static world mesh drawer. The defaults give the original PS1 look: texture_filter (0 = nearest, 1 = bilinear, 2 = bilinear with mipmaps), vertex_snap (true keeps the PS1 vertex jitter), affine_warp (true keeps the PS1 texture warp, false is perspective-correct), smooth_shading (Gouraud light on polygons the original shaded flat), msaa_samples (0 = off, else 2/4/8/16), edge_smoothing (0 = off, 1 = FXAA-like), dither (true keeps the 15-bit colour dither) and draw_distance_pct (draw distance in percent; 100 = the original). A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.
